body:

Preserve explicit full catalog output, command admission, matched prompts, acceptance checks and baseline.

Qualification: exact owning help contracts; actual diagnostic-help producer before rebuilding consumers; installed capsule/source-digest owning checks where affected. No full suite. No claimed net-token or billed-cost gain: retained bytes and temporal exposure do not establish retransmission or billing. Rebenchmark only after the larger compiler implementation batch is qualified.
